name: Eco Recycling Ltd (Ecoreco)
tagline: India's oldest listed e-waste recycler with headline 25%+ ROCE and zero debt - but the ValuePickr thread documents an auditor-resignation pattern, a management that stopped holding concalls, a 660-day cash conversion cycle and a fixed-asset base that does not match the capacity-expansion story
business_overview: Eco Recycling Ltd (BSE/NSE: ECORECO), promoted by B K Soni, provides e-waste collection, dismantling/shredding, data destruction, IT asset disposition (ITAD), lamp recycling, precious-metal recovery and EPR compliance services, plus mobile 'Recycling on Wheels' units. Stated recycling capacity ~31,200 MTPA. Promoter-managed; the company has repeatedly failed to attract institutional investors.
fundamentals_table: ~50-70% reported - unusually high; has been compressing (73% -> 50% -> 58%)
~660 days (highest in 10+ years) per thread analysis
2026-04-28: Q4FY26 sales +90% YoY to Rs 18.6 Cr, net profit +250% YoY to Rs 7 Cr, OPM ~69%; QoQ sales +215%, PAT +248%
fundamentals_narrative: On screener the company looks pristine - ~25% ROCE, ~69% ROE, zero debt, 50%+ EBITDA margins, and a Q4FY26 that jumped +90% revenue / +250% PAT. The ValuePickr thread pulls that apart. The Q4 spike is a bounce off collapsed Sep/Dec-2025 quarters; on a full-year / annualised basis a thread contributor calculates sales DOWN ~11% while listed peers grew, with EBITDA margin down from ~71% to ~58%. The cash conversion cycle has blown out to ~660 days - a decade high - and the reported ~50-70% margins on what is largely a collection-and-sell-to-smelter operation are contested. Most seriously, the thread documents (i) three auditor resignations in six years, one just 33 days before FY-end followed by a quick reappointment; (ii) no investor concall since August 2024, with promoters not responding to shareholder emails; (iii) a Plant & Machinery base that barely moved while capacity was claimed to rise ~400% (spend went into Land & Buildings); and (iv) the most-liked post in the thread (18 likes) showing management gave two contradictory accounts of a January-2025 factory fire - 'small, quickly resumed' in one concall, then 'a month of lost sales' when the next quarter missed.
technical_read: Not pulled. Stock had a sharp fall into early 2026 on the weak results / governance concerns.
sentiment_summary: Thread 331 (eco-recycling-limited-ecoreco, cat 11, 129 posts). First-time deep read - most recent ~45 posts. Sentiment has turned decisively negative through 2024-2026: from valuation debates (102x P/E) to detailed governance and accounting-quality critiques. Key contributors: Sachin_Malik (fire contradiction, 18 likes), Dhan77 (auditor pattern + CCC + no concalls), BILAL_HUSAIN (asset-base vs capacity mismatch; EPR-certificate-selling industry malpractice concern), kaveer (whether full recycling is actually done; margin sustainability).
community_signal: No trusted-roster user has a live call here. Community consensus is now sceptical-to-negative: multiple independent contributors flag governance, disclosure and accounting-quality concerns; several have written to the company and received no response.
key_new_facts: Auditor resignation pattern: three auditor resignations in six years, the latest ~33 days before FY-end with a rapid reappointment (thread, Dhan77) - a HIGH CAUTION trigger.
No investor concall since August 2024; promoters do not respond to shareholder emails (multiple contributors).
Cash conversion cycle ~660 days, a 10+-year high; working-capital days rising; operating cash flow weak despite reported profits.
Fixed-asset mismatch: capacity claimed up ~400% (7,200 -> 31,200 MTPA) but Plant & Machinery barely rose - spend went into Land & Buildings (BILAL_HUSAIN).
Management gave contradictory accounts of the Jan-2025 fire across two consecutive concalls (Sachin_Malik, 18 likes).
Full-year FY26 revenue is down ~11% YoY per thread analysis, even though the Sovrenn-flagged Q4 print was +90% - the Q4 is a bounce off a depressed base, not a clean inflection.

value_chain.position: Collection, dismantling, shredding, data destruction and ITAD; sells recovered plastics/metals onward - does not appear to do full downstream smelting / refining in-house
value_chain.bottleneck_node: EPR-certificate issuance capacity and utility/OEM empanelment; downstream metal value accrues to smelters/refiners
value_chain.note: E-waste formalisation under tightening EPR rules is a genuine multi-year tailwind, but it is drawing in capacity fast and the economics favour players that actually do downstream metal recovery. Peers (Namo, Gravita) grew while Ecoreco's revenue slipped - a company-specific execution / governance problem, not a sector problem.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: Reported YoY: strong through FY24, then Q2FY26 income +4% with EBITDA -29% and margin 74% -> 50%; H1FY26 income +2.7%, PAT -16%; full-year FY26 revenue ~-11% per thread analysis; Q4FY26 +90% is a rebound off two weak quarters.
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: Even on annualised recent PAT the stock is ~25x with revenue shrinking and governance overhang - the multiple assumes a re-acceleration the recent record does not support.

bull_case: Longest-established listed e-waste player; certified facilities; part of the TERRA global ITAD network
Zero reported debt and, on paper, very high returns and margins
Structural EPR-driven formalisation tailwind for organised e-waste recyclers
Optionality in Li-ion battery recycling (6,000 MTPA plant plans; C-MET/MeitY tie-up) and a ~Rs 500 Cr QIP raised for forward integration
bear_case: HIGH CAUTION: auditor resignation pattern (3 in 6 years; one 33 days before FY-end) plus rapid reappointment
Management stopped holding concalls (none since Aug 2024) and does not respond to shareholders - poor governance / disclosure
660-day cash conversion cycle; weak operating cash flow despite reported profits; working-capital days rising
Fixed-asset base inconsistent with the ~400% capacity-expansion claim; contested whether reported 50-70% margins are sustainable or the recycling is even completed in-house
Full-year revenue declining while peers grow; the Sovrenn-flagged Q4 spike is a low-base rebound, not an inflection
Contradictory management statements on the Jan-2025 fire undermine concall credibility
verdict_headline: HIGH CAUTION - governance and accounting-quality overhang (auditor churn, no concalls, 660-day CCC, asset/capacity mismatch, contradictory fire disclosures); the Sovrenn Q4 print does not hold up against a declining full year. thesis_fit 'neither', conviction Low
verdict_reasoning: Sovrenn-news seed (tier 4.65). The Sovrenn trigger (Q4FY26 +90% sales / +250% PAT) does NOT hold up: thread analysis shows full-year FY26 revenue down ~11% with margin compression - Q4 is a rebound off two collapsed quarters, not a live inflection.

Deep read of thread 331 uncovers a HIGH CAUTION cluster: three auditor resignations in six years (one 33 days pre-FY-end), no investor concall since Aug 2024 with unresponsive promoters, a ~660-day cash conversion cycle, a fixed-asset base that does not match the ~400% capacity-expansion claim, and the most-liked post documenting contradictory management accounts of the Jan-2025 fire. Per the red-flag rules an auditor resignation is a HIGH CAUTION trigger - keep researching but cap conviction and name the concern.
